message:
Design the complete native Android mobile experience for BioPulse — Biomedical Intelligence Dashboard, an academic hospital research patient-monitoring system. Create ALL TEN cohesive screens in this one run: 1 Secure Login, 2 Overview / Monitoring Summary, 3 Active Patient List with search/filter, 4 Patient Detail and Latest Vitals, 5 Live ECG / PPG / Respiration Monitoring, 6 Historical Trends and Date-Range Selection, 7 Alert Center, 8 Detailed Alert Information, 9 Patient Monitoring Report, 10 Profile and Notification Preferences. This is design and HTML reference output for later Java + Android XML Material Components implementation, not React. Plan the full system before drawing screens.

Style direction: precise, calm, sophisticated professional monitoring workstation translated to Android. Dark charcoal/slate monitoring surfaces, subtle cool neutral dividers, off-white readable text, restrained teal primary actions; signal color identity ECG green, PPG cyan, respiration violet; severity red/amber/green always accompanied by explicit text and icons. Clean sans typography with tabular numerical vitals, compact hierarchy but readable values and units, consistent 8-point spacing, modest 10-12dp card corners, flat bordered cards without shadows, no gradients/glass/decorative illustrations or fake clinical indicators. Use standard Android top bars and labeled bottom navigation Overview / Patients / Alerts / Profile, consistent clinical masthead and data provenance strips, meticulous timestamps and waveform grid. Charts use real-looking de-identified research shapes and clearly labeled synthetic/replay fixtures, no photos. Distinctive details: colored waveform lead labels and compact explicit recording-coverage rails. Include a visible light theme preview in Preferences as well as dark default.

Use internally consistent synthetic fixture: 12 patients monitored, 2 critical and 3 warning simulated OPEN physiological events, 10 devices online and 2 offline. Patient PT-0247, pseudonym Avery R., Ward B / Bed 12, research admission: post-procedure observation, no real identity. Snapshot 25 Oct 2026 14:08:00 IST: HR 108 bpm, SpO2 94%, RR 22 breaths/min, BP 128/82 mmHg, temperature 37.1°C. Device MON-012 online, ECG quality good, PPG fair, respiration good. This is REPLAY data (not live acquisition), recording exactly 14:00:00–14:08:00 IST (8 minutes), usable 7m45s, missing 14:04:10–14:04:25. Latest sample timestamp distinct from UI freshness. All trend charts constrain data to that 8-minute recording; show unrecorded ranges as empty rather than invented 24h points.

Login: hospital research identity, email/password, reveal password, sign in, session/security feedback, demo research disclaimer. Overview: monitored patients, active simulated critical/warning counts, online/offline device counts, recently updated patients, prioritized events. Patient list: search code/pseudonym, ward and status filters, labeled status and update age. Patient detail: code/pseudonym, ward/bed/admission, ALL six vitals and units, waveforms previews, source and quality, device status and last received, coverage and experimental analytics badge with explanation. Live monitoring: ECG/PPG/respiration separate strips, lead labels, scale/time units, quality, Replay badge, play/pause replay + scrub speed, disconnected/stale example state clearly designed. Replay pause must retain timestamp. Trends: date range, coverage, time-series with explicit missing-data gap, current/mean/min/max, direction, events over time, experimental anomaly explanation, side-by-side vital comparisons (independent labeled axes; no misleading scales). Alert Center: physiology vs sensor/disconnection/missing-data types, severity + state Open/Acknowledged/Resolved, filtering, event timeline. Detailed alert: use resolved prior simulated SpO2 89% at 14:03:12, rule SpO2 <90% for 20s, duration 26s, PPG quality fair, linked patient, recorded acknowledgment/resolution timeline and responsible research user, explanation and acknowledgment control when open. Sensor disconnection must be visibly distinct from physiological criticality. Report: printable monitoring report preview with pseudonymous metadata, 8-minute interval, 96.9% coverage, six-vital statistics, gaps, event summary, experimental outputs research-only and PDF export affordance. Profile: research staff role, ward scope, notifications by severity/type, text+icon settings, theme dark/light/system, session sign-out.

All clinical scores / AI outputs labeled experimental, research/demo only; no independent client risk engine. Include loading, empty, API error, offline and stale patterns consistently, perhaps as compact supporting state examples where relevant. Never imply offline/stale values are current. Data sources shared Spring Boot REST plus WebSocket; show source badges Synthetic identity / Research waveform / Replay / Missing. Prefer complete thoughtfully composed scrollable screens over placeholder text. Deliver editable rendered screens and complete per-screen HTML references.
